metrics.name: gap_reduction_pct
metrics.definition: relative free-boundary gap reduction vs standard BCCB wrapping: 100*(1 - g_approx/g_bccb), g = ||f_approx - f_free||/||f_free||

metrics.name: relative_system_residual
metrics.definition: the pinned boundary win-rule residual ||(K_free + lam I) alpha_hat - y||/||y|| (KKT-style, identical convention to the PCG reference); PCG ref per-field 4.69e-9..9.81e-9 at tol 1e-8 (T1b canonical)

metrics.name: capture_vs_dst2_pct
metrics.definition: S1' capture of the DST2 comparator's own gap reduction (>= 50% required for WIN)

metrics.name: w_guard
metrics.definition: w <= min(H,W)/8 per grid (structural via the clamp w_design = min(ceil(2.5*rho), min(H,W)/8))

metrics.name: cond_wtt
metrics.definition: measured per-grid condition estimate of the SPD center WTT = M^{-1}[T,T]

metrics.name: support_rank_s
metrics.definition: |S| with S = {cells: |H_r| > 1e-6 * max|H_r|} (support set of the tail coupling)

metrics.name: support_distance_w_s
metrics.definition: measured numerical support distance of the tail coupling

metrics.name: coverage_ratio
metrics.definition: s/|T_w| - band coverage of the full support, per grid/kernel

metrics.name: n_negative_eigenvalues
metrics.definition: per grid/kernel, on every boundary/masked artifact (iteration-3 A1 convention: n_negative_eigenvalues_by_grid)

metrics.name: rmse_valid_only
metrics.definition: RMSE on valid (mask-excluded) cells; valid-only denominator everywhere (T1b valid-cell domain)

metrics.name: wall_clock_s
metrics.definition: median wall-clock over repeats (warm-up excluded), monotonic timestamps around each arm, consistent with iteration-2/3 accounting; 0.1 s rounding disclosure honored

metrics.name: peak_rss_gb
metrics.definition: peak resident set size (resource.getrusage, metrics.py ResourceRecorder)

metrics.name: iterations_to_tol
metrics.definition: iterations to relative KKT/system residual tolerance (PCG and masked solver, same convention)

metrics.name: relative_residual
metrics.definition: final relative residual r_t / ||y_m|| (masked arm) or ||(K+lam I) alpha_hat - y||/||y|| (boundary arm)

metrics.name: speedup_vs_pcg
metrics.definition: median wall-clock PCG / wall-clock masked solver at equivalent KKT residual < 1e-6 (primary) / 1e-8 (matched)

metrics.name: est_spectral_fit_flops
metrics.definition: rfft+irfft flop estimate (metrics.py est_spectral_fit_flops)

metrics.name: est_spectral_bytes
metrics.definition: spectrum + field + alpha byte estimate (metrics.py est_spectral_bytes ~ 40*N)

metrics.name: accuracy_per_flop
metrics.definition: valid-only RMSE quality per estimated flop (solve-cost control framing)

metrics.name: accuracy_per_byte
metrics.definition: valid-only RMSE quality per estimated byte (memory-control framing)

metrics.name: fail_fast
metrics.definition: row flag: non-monotone w-sweep residual decay (boundary arm); recorded per grid (iteration-3: 9/141, all 64x64 [honest negative])
